label: dam-probe-p7
_why: ENGINE PROBE p7 of the REDESIGNED dams (user, 2026-09-26: one building per project with levels instead of stage buildings; the overlord must be able to build and own the dam in a subject's state; ownership must never evaporate on privatisation; always subsidised; builders share the levels like a deposit). ARM = config/mod_config.canon-dams-probe.json {kind: config}: the canon + the power plant at 1,600 + the dams on the final 159-project table + probe settings (the three class technologies granted to GBR FRA USA RUS PRU AUS SWE SAR SWI TUR at the start, 2-month surveys, level cost x0.05, the USA and France switched to Laissez-faire). Design: group under bg_private_infrastructure (not government-funded), can_build_private always no, can_build_government reads scope:investor_country (chain, its own survey, the next level's class technology), the level cap by level_after_queued_constructions, potential restricted to the anchor's split part, ai_privatization_deisre 1000, must_have subsidies. The AI driver surveys for AI countries and queues levels only where the country OWNS the anchor state. P7 over p6 (20260926_184541): p6 showed a scripted start in a subject state lands in the SUBJECT queue (stuck forever in subjects without construction), the engine AI never queues a dam, every dam is owned by its host government (Laissez-faire USA/France included, no privatisation), and the documented ai_privatization_deisre key is rejected (now ai_nationalization_desire 0.75). P7 replaces the race test with a FINANCE test: at an overlord survey of a subject site, create_building with add_ownership = the overlord (twice for multi-level projects).

_questions.Q1: Does create_building with add_ownership work in an effect and give the OVERLORD the levels (the save)?
_questions.Q2: Does a second create_building add a level to the existing dam?

_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Probe build: techs granted, costs and surveys shrunk - do not read any economic number from it.
